evals.prompt: Fais-moi une veille sur le commerce agentique, juste ce qui est sorti aujourd'hui.
evals.expected_output: A brief written in French (language of the request): header with subject, 1-day window and date; 3 articles each summarized in 3 bullets with source, date, publisher URL (never news.google.com), a 'Why it matters' line, a 'Corroborated by' line and a key; the 7 other candidates listed with keys; the script was run once, at most 10 tavily_search and 2 tavily_extract calls, then mark was executed with the 3 keys.

evals.prompt: What happened around Shopify this week? I want the 3 stories that matter for a PM, with sources.
evals.expected_output: Brief in English, 7-day window explicitly requested (--days 7, no widening), 3 stories with corroboration lines and keys, 7 others listed, mark executed at the end.

evals.prompt: Reject b9f2634d7c7a, I already know that story. And tell me how many articles I've seen in total.
evals.expected_output: Runs `fetch_news.py reject b9f2634d7c7a`, then `stats`, and answers with the total number of records and the split by status, without launching a new brief.

evals.prompt: Email me a brief on agentic commerce from the last 3 days.
evals.expected_output: Same fetch/Tavily flow with --days 3. The brief is written as JSON to ~/.market-intelligence/briefs/<run_id>.json, rendered with `render_email.py render`, then sent with the Resend MCP send-email tool to the configured address (from onboarding@resend.dev), with subject/html/text passed verbatim and no cc/bcc/replyTo. Chat reply is a few lines: recipient, 3 headlines, html_path (no full brief). `mark` runs after the send.

evals.prompt: Give me a news brief on Shopify today.
evals.expected_output: Chat delivery only: markdown brief in the mandated format. render_email.py is not run and no email is sent, because the user did not say 'email me'.

evals.prompt: Email me a brief on composable commerce. (Simulate: the Resend send-email call is rejected with a permission or domain error.)
evals.expected_output: One sentence stating the send failed with the error, then the full chat brief in the standard template ending with an italic line 'Email not sent: <reason>.'; `mark` still runs afterwards.

evals.prompt: Email me a brief on Shopify from the last 3 days. (Simulate: the Resend MCP connector is not connected, and RESEND_API_KEY is set.)
evals.expected_output: Same fetch/Tavily flow. Because no `send-email` tool exists, the brief JSON is written and `render_email.py send --input <json>` is run instead of `render` (the HTML never enters the context and no MCP call is attempted). Chat reply is a few lines with recipient, 3 headlines and html_path; the API key is never printed or requested in chat. `mark` runs after the send.

evals.prompt: Email me a brief on Shopify. (Simulate: MCP not connected and no API key anywhere.)
evals.expected_output: `render_email.py send` exits 3; the reply tells the user, in one sentence, to set $RESEND_API_KEY or run `config --api-key` themselves (never asks them to paste the key in chat), then gives the full chat brief ending with the italic line 'Email not sent: ...'; `mark` still runs.
